createdProgramBoundaries.activationCondition: Pursue this package when testing whether finite blocking, correlated product inputs, or joint envelope auxiliaries can improve these particular separately relaxed UV scalar converses per channel use.
createdProgramBoundaries.directResidualWorkScope: Prove or refute exact product additivity of the averaged separately relaxed UV rows, determine when receiver symmetry equates their branchwise minimum with the average, and specialize the conclusion to finite BSSC products. The accepted results exhaust this scope.
createdProgramBoundaries.independentVariationRationale: The additivity theorem and symmetry specialization form one dependency-ordered chain controlling one continue-or-prune decision, so they are not split. The package is independent of the code-induced converse route: it merely uses an accepted BSSC posterior-support result, and pursuit of this UV route is not conditional on pursuing the existing code-induced programs.
createdProgramBoundaries.stoppingCondition: Stop when exact tensorization and the symmetry bridge are proved or decisively refuted with the BSSC consequence determined. The accepted results satisfy this condition and show that the resulting BSSC value is non-frontier.

createdProgramWithAccessAnnotations.rationale: The two accepted results completely settle the stated finite-product relaxed-UV scalar package and establish its non-frontier BSSC consequence, leaving no direct residual work. Incidence is certain because this accepted, completed package is part of the post-submission reference portfolio and remains active for same-world counterfactual accounting.

createdPrograms.currentStateSummary: Exact product additivity holds for the averaged relaxed-UV scalar on arbitrary finite-alphabet DMBC products. Receiver-exchanging involutive symmetry equates the branchwise minimum with that scalar and preserves additivity, yielding the non-frontier BSSC value 2h_2(1/4)-5/4 per use at every finite product length.
createdPrograms.localResidualSummary: The stated blocking and symmetry package is complete, so its direct residual work is zero. Complete-UV-region coupling, other weighted scalarizations, GK constructions, and full-Theorem-9 constraints are outside this package.

rootBoundary.activationCondition: The root remains active while the canonical exact BSSC sum-capacity objective is unresolved.
rootBoundary.directResidualWorkScope: Carry out unresolved achievability and converse research not assigned to existing children or the completed UV-scalar package; investigate structures not eliminated by the scalar tensorization theorem, including coupling between UV branches and richer auxiliary constraints; coordinate independent routes; and integrate and certify a matching exact capacity result. This excludes the technical reduction and channel-specific-refinement work already assigned to the existing code-induced children.
rootBoundary.independentVariationRationale: Root direct work contains genuine integration and uninstantiated alternative research whose estimates can vary independently of the existing code-induced children and the completed UV-scalar package; child technical work is excluded to prevent duplication.
rootBoundary.stoppingCondition: Stop only when an accepted result matches rigorous achievability and converse values and satisfies all limiting, cardinality, and certification requirements in the root contract.

rootWithAccessAnnotation.rationale: The accepted UV theorem prunes the finite-blocking route for these separately relaxed scalars but does not move a governed capacity endpoint or resolve the canonical problem. The estimate covers the still-broad uninstantiated achievability, alternative-converse, integration, and certification work while excluding both existing code-induced child work and the now-completed UV package.

topologyRationale: One new root child is the minimal topology. Both fixed results belong to a single dependency-ordered theorem chain with one stopping policy: determine whether blocking can strengthen the specified separately relaxed UV scalars. Splitting them would not preserve an independently variable accounting term. The new package is a sibling of the existing code-induced converse route because using its accepted posterior-support result is a mathematical dependency, not conditional-pursuit ancestry.
